# Dependency lock for CI. Regenerate with:
#
#     uv pip compile pyproject.toml --extra dev --python-version 3.12 \
#         -c <(pip freeze --exclude-editable) --generate-hashes -o requirements-dev.txt

# Resolved for Python 3.12 (what CI runs) and hash-pinned, per Phase A spec
# §6 "pin, don't float".

# Constrained to the versions currently installed and verified against, NOT to
# the newest resolvable set. That is deliberate: atlas.runners.resume
# classifies provider failures by real SDK exception classes, and its comments
# record confirming that taxonomy against openai 3.3.1, anthropic 1.0.0 and
# google-genai 2.20.0 specifically. An unconstrained resolve moved anthropic to
# 1.2.0, which would have silently put CI on a class hierarchy nobody had
# checked. Bump these deliberately, re-confirming the taxonomy when you do.
# "verified-installed-versions" in a "via" comment marks a pin that came from
# that constraint set.
